headline: Pakistan Aims to Increase Gemstone Exports to $1 Billion Within Five Years
summary: Pakistan plans to increase its gemstone exports to $1 billion within five years through value addition, international certification, and modern mining techniques.
why: Export diversification and value addition in mineral resources support foreign exchange earnings and industrial development.

impacts.name: Mining & Exports
impacts.why: Targeting export growth promotes investment in domestic gemstone mining and processing.
